summary: Kaniksu NF lookout in Bonner County: 50-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, built 1935, destroyed about 1961. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 50-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: All three sources date its destruction to about 1961. No source describes what, if anything, remains.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

notes_for_editor: The three sources agree on 1935 build, the 50-foot L-4 design and destruction around 1961. The Forest Lookouts page credits its 1961 date to a source it names Kresek; the sources may not be independent of one another. Record height_m 15.2 is consistent with 50 ft (15.24 m), but the sources give pole height, not cab-floor height, so no height fact was written. The FFLOS entry 'Round Top Mountain Lookout Site' in search results is the Clearwater NF Round Top (us-id-round-top-mountain-2), not this one; it was not used. Nothing says what remains at the site today.
